sections.details: This registry collects pending references and their planning context for the corpus. The upcoming-reference kind is one logical collection of links from current entry blocks to future mathematical areas. Integration tasks, cross-area correspondences, source plans and deferred extensions use separate record kinds. The mathematical-logic development context has its own focused record. These notes do not authorize new entries or certify prerequisites. Follow the prerequisite and scope policy in CONTRIBUTING.md; proposed titles suggest future coverage.

When revising a consuming entry, inspect the target block and its assumptions,
then add a link where it helps. These records use the integration kind rather than the
upcoming-reference kind because the targets already exist. Some targets provide only
a foundation for the fuller future-area treatment.

These comparisons are not claims currently used in the entries. Prove the
correspondence in the relevant future area before using it as a reference for the
current order-based treatment.

The planned entries in these records have no drafted block IDs yet. During drafting,
identify the actual consuming blocks and add links only where their arguments
use the stated facts. These records identify useful existing targets, not complete
prerequisite coverage for each planned entry.
